corrections.old_text: ፻፯ ፮ ፫ ፬ ፳፪ ፮ ፵፪
corrections.corrected_text: ፶፭ ፮ ፫ ፬ ፳፪ ፮ ፵፪
corrections.reason: The Ethiopic numeral is ፶፭ (55, referring to Matthew 13:55), which was misread as ፻፯ due to ink bleed on the numeral bars.
The verse reference for Matthew 13:57 is printed as ፶፯ (misread as ፻፮) and Luke 4:24 is printed as ፳፬ (misread as ፳፮).

corrections.old_text: ፳፪ ፵፭ ፲፪ ፲፪ ፲፱ ፴፪
corrections.corrected_text: ፳፩ ፵፭ ፲፪ ፲፪ ፲፱ ፴፪
corrections.reason: The chapter reference for Matthew 21:45 is printed as ፳፩, which was misread as ፳፪.
The text abbreviates ክልኤ ('two') using the Ethiopic numeral ፪ followed by the phonetic complement ኤ (፪ኤ መዋዕል, cf. Matthew 26:2), which Stage 1 misread as ይእ.
